context.guidance: Serve every route that carries Personal Data over TLS only, and set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite attributes on session cookies. Replace wildcard cross-origin rules with an explicit list of trusted origins. These transport and session controls are part of the safeguards Rule 6(1)(a) requires for the Personal Data they carry.

value.fix: Set the security attributes on the token cookie instead of using the bare call: res.cookie('token', token, { httpOnly: true, secure: true, sameSite: 'strict' }). HttpOnly blocks JavaScript access to the token, Secure limits it to HTTPS, and SameSite reduces cross-site request exposure. Serve the application over TLS only so Secure cookies are sent, and replace any wildcard CORS origin with an explicit allowlist of trusted origins. Verify by inspecting the Set-Cookie response header in a test request, confirming it includes HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict.
